candidate.name: TesterArmy
candidate.one_liner: Agents that test web and mobile apps

provenance.title: Launch HN: TesterArmy (YC P26) – Agents that test web and mobile apps

facts.statement: TesterArmy is built by Szymon Rybczak (Co-founder & CEO) and Oskar Kwaśniewski (Co-founder & CTO).
Szymon Rybczak is a React Native contributor and conference speaker with years of experience building developer tools in the open-source ecosystem.
Oskar Kwaśniewski is a React Native core contributor with over 100 merged PRs and creator of React Native visionOS, Bottom Tabs, and Liquid Glass.

TesterArmy is described as an agentic testing platform that runs end-to-end checks before deployment and in production, letting users specify tests in natural language and handling everything in between.
facts.value: Agents that test web and mobile apps

facts.statement: TesterArmy's product is for engineers and teams to create and run automated AI-agent driven tests on web and mobile apps to catch bugs before deployment and in production.
TesterArmy claims to be an AI-agent testing automation platform that replaces brittle scripts with AI agents that test web and mobile apps like real users do.
TesterArmy depends on AI and recent advances in AI coding tools and models such as GPT-5.6 Luna for its agentic testing capabilities.
TesterArmy is a hosted service where the user describes tests in natural language and the AI agent handles test execution including clicks, typing, and verification in real browsers.
TesterArmy's AI agents have persistent memory that learns from past test runs and remembers context across sessions to improve reliability.
Users can start using TesterArmy by signing up through their website with no credit card required and run their first tests in under five minutes.
TesterArmy publicly lists monthly pricing plans starting at $99 per month for solo builders and $299 per month for small teams, with enterprise plans available by contacting sales.
Enterprise customers need to book a call for custom limits, self-hosting options, single sign-on, and dedicated support.
The Hacker News launch post for TesterArmy received 132 points and 69 comments 65 days ago from the date of retrieval.
Named customers of TesterArmy include Novu, HireVoice, CodeCrafters, Copyfy, Lightsprint, Standout, Cube, and Regbase.
TesterArmy integrates with GitHub, Slack, Discord, Expo, Vercel, webhooks, and supports CI/CD systems like GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.
The team behind TesterArmy is stated as two engineers, Szymon Rybczak and Oskar Kwaśniewski, on the About page.
